note: City of Atchison's Warnock Lake park: an oval loop of parallel RV sites south of the lake, beside the caretaker's house and restrooms, with tent camping nearby and a disc golf course. Campers in 2025 report self-pay registration, no reservations, 30/50 A electric with a water spigot (no sewer), showers, a 14-day limit, and the nearest dump station about 2-3 miles away in town. The park closes 11 pm-7 am. --Claude
summary: City page confirms a campground, its park map places '16 RV Camping' on the oval loop and gives the Parks Dept 913-367-5561; nothing on rates, counts or rules. Directory-derived hookups/count/showers/water/booking cleared; vault toilets from the map. $5 honor system is stale (2025 campers: $15, $12 seniors). Lakefront -> lakeview proposed; pin ~600 m off.
flags: WATERFRONT (apply.py doesn't write it): stored 'lakefront' -> propose LAKEVIEW (soft; NOT WATERFRONT if AWH prefers the stricter reading). Warnock Lake is ~500 x 400 m on imagery (roughly 15-20 ha, well over the ~5-acre pond line), so it is a lake. But the RV loop (city map '16 RV Camping') sits ~100-150 m south of the water, with the caretaker house, maintenance shop and the park road between the loop and the shore - a developed strip, so lakefront is not earned. The leaf-off frame shows lawn with scattered trees from the loop's NE end toward the lake ~100 m away, so a view is plausible but not confirmed in summer; unsure, so it goes down.

PIN MOVE: stored 39.54064,-95.1517 is at the park's north entrance road ~600 m north of the RV loop. Move to the loop centre ~39.5348,-95.1523 (Google's place point 39.53562,-95.15137 is ~100 m NE of it, at the caretaker area).
